description: This file implements a simple file-based storage system for a bike rental management system, including data models, seed data, and methods for reading, writing, and querying JSON data.

classes.name: JsonFileStorage
classes.description: A small file-based storage class for managing data related to users, bikes, and rentals in a bike rental system.

methods.name: _utc_ts
methods.description: Returns the current UTC Unix timestamp in seconds.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the storage, creating directories and seed data if necessary.

methods.name: _seed
methods.description: Provides initial seed data for users, bikes, and rentals.

methods.name: _read
methods.description: Reads the entire dataset from the JSON file.

methods.name: _write
methods.description: Writes data to the JSON file atomically.

methods.name: get_all
methods.description: Returns a copy of the full dataset.

methods.name: update_all
methods.description: Overwrites the dataset with new data.

methods.name: next_id
methods.description: Calculates the next available ID for a given collection.

methods.name: find_one
methods.description: Finds the first item matching provided filters.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists items optionally filtered by criteria.
